medium.en: Handscroll; ink, color, and gold on paper

dimensions.en: Image: 9 1/8 x 36 1/2 in. (23.2 x 92.7 cm); Overall with mounting: 11 x 418 13/16 in. (27.9 x 1063.8 cm)

credit_line.en: Ex coll.: C. C. Wang Family, Gift of The Dillon Fund, 1973

intro.zh: 1276年南宋都城杭州陷落后，钱选选择做一名“遗民”，不在新朝做官。
intro.en: After the fall of Hangzhou, the Southern Song capital, in 1276, Qian Xuan chose to live as a yimin, a 'leftover subject' of the fallen dynasty.

intro.zh: 这幅手卷画的是书法大师王羲之（303–361）的故事；传说他从鹅颈优雅的转动等自然形态中得到启发。
intro.en: This scroll tells the story of the master calligrapher Wang Xizhi (303–361), who was said to draw inspiration from natural forms such as the graceful movement of a goose's neck.

intro.zh: 画用有意古拙的“青绿”画法；大都会博物馆认为，这种如梦的、不真实的空间，表达了宋亡之后画家内心的断裂感。
intro.en: It is painted in a deliberately primitive 'blue-and-green' style; the Met reads its dreamlike, unreal space as Qian Xuan's way of expressing the break he felt after the fall of the Song.

look_for.zh: 亭子里穿白袍的王羲之，旁边站着一个小童。
look_for.en: Wang Xizhi in his white robe in the pavilion, with a young servant beside him.

look_for.zh: 亭子右边水面上游着的鹅。
look_for.en: The geese swimming on the water to the right of the pavilion.

look_for.zh: 左边四行字是钱选自题的诗，诗中说王羲之为道士写《道德经》，留下“爱鹅”的风流佳话。
look_for.en: At the left, Qian Xuan's own four-line poem, which recalls Wang Xizhi writing out the Daode jing for a Daoist and leaving behind the romantic image of 'a man who loves geese'.

alt.zh: 一幅色彩明亮的手卷：树丛中有一座亭子，亭中有穿白衣的人物，湖面上有鹅，左边是青绿色的山丘，最左边有一段书法。
alt.en: A brightly coloured handscroll: a pavilion among trees with a figure in white, geese on a lake, blue and green hills to the left, and a passage of calligraphy at the far left.

image_choice.note: Stitched from two Met Open Access section photographs and cropped to the painting.

views.zh: 他在签条上题写此画是钱选的真迹，并盖上“神品”印。
views.en: On the label strip he wrote that it is a genuine work by Qian Xuan, and stamped it with a seal reading 'divine class' (神品).

quote.zh: 錢選觀鵝圖真跡，内府御玩
quote.en: a genuine work; a delight for imperial enjoyment

note.zh: 每一句都对照所注出处核对过；找不到可靠出处的说法已删去或改写。
note.en: Every sentence was checked against the sources it cites; claims without a reliable source were cut or rewritten.
